turns.assessment: The only positive equipment change is the +1.52% pump-current excursion at oms.S21-S06.amp3, consistent with compensated pump-current drift, but that amplifier is on the S21→S06 route and does not explain frozen telemetry at trx.och166.z on the S15–S04–S14 lightpath. A failure of trx.och166.z is also poorly supported: a CARD_FAIL should make monitoring invalid and cause loss at the far-end receiver, whereas both och166 endpoints and all intervening optical monitors remained unchanged. The evidence therefore points more toward an undocumented telemetry/staleness issue than a listed transport fault.

proposals.rationale: A local card failure is the closest documented mode to frozen receiver telemetry, but it should also interrupt both directions and make monitoring invalid; no corresponding change appears at trx.och166.a or along the optical path.
This could be local to the receiver, but it should produce receiver penalties or BER degradation rather than merely static rx_power; pre-FEC BER, OSNR, DGD, and SOP rate also showed no change.

The observed pump-current excursion with unchanged input and output power matches compensated pump ageing, but this amplifier is not on the och166 path and the excursion occurred after the estimated onset, so it is unlikely to cause the queried behavior.

score.why: cause flagged as unconsidered and absent
